assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Sony Music India 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Sony Music India / Sony Pictures Networks India，还是其他 Sony 实体？企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别（音乐）。
  7. 内容供应模式：授权音乐曲库。
  8. 代表作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Sony Music India 排名第 17 名，历史累计观看量约为 85B（850 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。 需与同样由 Sony 所有的 SET India 区分开。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Sony Music India 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
Sony Music India YouTube Channel — Comprehensive Dossier

1. Stable Channel ID & Canonical URLs

  • Channel ID: UC56gTxNs4f9xZ7Pa2i5xNzg
  • Canonical channel URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC56gTxNs4f9xZ7Pa2i5xNzg — consistently resolves to Sony Music India across all Google search results and platform references.
  • Handle URL: https://www.youtube.com/@SonyMusicIndia
  • Alias URL: https://www.youtube.com/c/SonyMusicIndia

All three URLs redirect to the same channel. Verified via Google search results listing @SonyMusicIndia with 72.9M subscribers • 12K videos [^1^][^3^].

Note: A separate channel exists as SonyMusicIndiaVEVO (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3MLnJtqc_phABBriLRhtgQ), described as "your premium destination for the most iconic and visually stunning music videos" — this is a secondary/legacy VEVO-branded channel, not the primary channel [^15^].

2. Operator & Corporate Chain

  • Operator: Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd. (legally incorporated in India)
  • Ownership chain: Sony Group Corporation (Japan) → Sony Music Entertainment (US) → Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd. (wholly owned subsidiary)

LinkedIn's corporate page states explicitly: "A wholly owned subsidiary of SONY MUSIC ENTERTAINMENT Inc, SONY MUSIC ENTERTAINMENT INDIA began operation in 1997" [^9^]. Wikipedia confirms: "Parent: Sony Music Entertainment" [^8^].

Critical distinction from SET India: Sony Music India is NOT operated by Sony Pictures Networks India (SPN) or Culver Max Entertainment. SET India (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpEhnqL0y41EpW2TvWAHD7Q, @SETIndia, ~190M subscribers) is owned by Sony Pictures Networks, a division of Sony Pictures Entertainment [^16^]. Sony Music Entertainment and Sony Pictures Networks are sister entities under the broader Sony Group but operate in entirely different divisions (recorded music vs. television broadcasting). They share no channel management.

3. Channel Creation Date & Earliest Still-Public Upload

  • Channel created: September 2, 2009 (confirmed by Social Blade [^3^] and Wikitubia [^2^])
  • Earliest still-public upload: October 5, 2009 — "Kuch Kuch Hota Hai- Official Video | Udit Narayan, Alka Yagnik | Shah Rukh Khan, Kajol, Rani Mukerji" (video ID eJF4DSekiKU), currently at ~45M views and still fully accessible [^4^][^2^]. The copyright notice on the video reads: "© 1998 Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd." [^4^].

4. Operating Location & Displayed Country

  • Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India [^8^]
  • Additional facility: Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Sony Music South division office) [^8^]
  • Displayed country: India — confirmed by Social Blade [^3^], VidIQ [^5^], and the channel handle/social media bios referencing India [^6^][^7^]. The channel's About section returned a 401 error during retrieval, but all third-party analytics platforms consistently report India as the country [^3^][^5^].

5. Languages

Primary language is Hindi, with significant content in multiple Indian languages. Wikipedia's filmography tables document releases in [^8^]:

  • Hindi (primary — Bollywood soundtracks)
  • Tamil (via Sony Music South, audio rights for 200+ Tamil films)
  • Telugu
  • Malayalam
  • Kannada
  • Bengali
  • Assamese
  • Punjabi
  • English (independent pop via Sony Music India Pop division)

6. Primary Content Category

Music. The channel description reads: "Welcome to Sony Music India's official YouTube channel, the ultimate destination for music enthusiasts and fans of the Indian music scene" [^1^]. All content consists of music videos, lyrical videos, albums, and music-related content. The channel is categorized as Music/Entertainment on all analytics platforms [^3^].

7. Content Supply Model

Licensed/owned music catalog. Sony Music Entertainment India operates as a record label that owns or administers rights to:

  • Bollywood film soundtracks (majority of uploads — e.g., Kuch Kuch Hota Hai, Lagaan, Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham, Dhadkan, Mimi, Ginny Weds Sunny, etc.)
  • Independent pop songs (via Sony Music India Pop division and direct artist signings)
  • South Indian film soundtracks (via Sony Music South)

The LinkedIn page confirms: "It boasts of an extensive catalogue and is home to renowned and celebrated artists and several iconic Bollywood Film soundtracks" [^9^]. Copyright notices on individual videos attribute rights to Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd. [^4^][^10^].

8. Representative Works (highest-viewing still-public uploads)

Video Views Upload Date Source
Dino James – Wishlist feat Kaprila | Official Music Video 101M+ Mar 19, 2020 [^10^]
LOL – Official Music Video | Ginny Weds Sunny 65M+ Sep 20, 2020 [^11^]
Gajendra Verma – Mann Mera (Original Version) 62M+ May 20, 2025 [^12^]
Kuch Kuch Hota Hai – Official Video 45M+ Oct 5, 2009 [^4^]

9. Current Scale (as of mid-September 2026)

  • Subscribers: ~72.9M [^3^]
  • Lifetime views: ~85.7B (Social Blade data as of Sept 17, 2026) [^3^]
  • Videos uploaded: ~12,556 [^3^]
  • Rank: Consistent with the orchestrator's Communitrics note (#17, ~85B views as of Sept 2, 2026) [^3^]
  • Grade: A+ [^3^]

Unresolved Issues

  • The YouTube channel's official About section (which would list exact language tags and possibly a "Country" field per YouTube's creator settings) returned HTTP 401 errors during automated retrieval, so those specific metadata fields could not be directly scraped. However, all third-party analytics platforms independently confirm India as the country, and the content catalog demonstrates multi-language output.
  • The precise monthly upload volume and internal content strategy (e.g., whether any uploads are licensed from other labels beyond Warner's former distribution deal, which ended March 2020) are not separately documented in available sources.

Sources Consulted:

[^2^] https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/Sony_Music_India — "On September 2, 2009, Sony Music India created their YouTube channel. The first video was uploaded on October 5, 2009..."
[^3^] https://socialblade.com/youtube/handle/sonymusicindia — Created On: Sep 2, 2009; ~73M subs; ~85.7B views; ~12,556 videos

[^5^] https://vidiq.com/youtube-stats/channel/@sonymusicindia/ — "Sony Music India started their YouTube channel on September 2, 2009... based in India"
[^6^] https://www.instagram.com/sonymusicindia/ — bio: "Hindi songs, Bollywood music... India"
[^7^] https://x.com/sonymusicindia/ — "The official Twitter handle of Sony Music India. India"
[^8^] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sony_Music_India — Parent: Sony Music Entertainment; Headquarters: Mumbai; Founded: 1997; Subsidiaries: Sony Music South
[^9^] https://in.linkedin.com/company/sonymusic-india — "A wholly owned subsidiary of SONY MUSIC ENTERTAINMENT Inc"
